import pathlib,json,hashlib,zipfile,datetime
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
out=root/'evidence/operations/recovery/run-01/evidence-validation.json'
assert not out.exists()
report=json.loads((out.parent/'report.json').read_text())
probe=json.loads((out.parent/'probe-report.json').read_text())
checks=[]
def check(name,value):
    checks.append({'check':name,'passed':bool(value)})
    assert value,name
check('source hashes still match executed inputs',all(sha(root/p)==h for p,h in report['inputs'].items()))
check('public artifacts match exact run hashes',all(sha(out.parent/r['path'])==r['sha256'] for r in report['artifacts']))
check('exact stage accounting',probe['executed']==20 and probe['passed']==19 and probe['characterized']==1 and probe['failed']==probe['unexecuted']==probe['skipped']==0)
check('no full acceptance claim',report['bounded_drill_passed'] and not report['full_recovery_qualified'] and not probe['full_AT_OPS_006_passed'] and not probe['foundation_passed'])
check('unchanged source and no Docker delta',report['source_services_unchanged'] and report['resources_restored'] and all(not r['added'] and not r['removed'] for r in report['resource_delta'].values()))
check('all nine owned containers recorded',len(report['created_containers'])==9 and len({r['id'] for r in report['created_containers']})==9)
check('all three authenticated payload hashes match',report['pack']['files']==report['unpack']['files'] and set(report['pack']['files'])=={'database.pgdump','core-config.yaml','runtime.env'})
check('archive retained with exact hash',sha(root/report['private_directory']/'backup.fernet')==report['pack']['archive_sha256'])
retired=set(report['duplicate_plaintext_removed'])
retained=[r for r in report['private_artifacts'] if (root/r['path']).exists()]
check('retained private artifacts match captured hashes',all(sha(root/r['path'])==r['sha256'] and (root/r['path']).stat().st_size==r['bytes'] for r in retained))
check('known duplicate plaintext removed',len(retired)==6 and all(not (root/p).exists() for p in retired))
check('real format unit tests passed',b'Ran 28 tests' in (out.parent/'bundle-unittest.log').read_bytes() and (out.parent/'bundle-unittest.log').read_bytes().rstrip().endswith(b'OK'))
state=json.loads((root/report['private_directory']/'worker/state.json').read_text())
secrets=[]
for user in state['users']:
    secrets.extend(v for k,v in user.items() if isinstance(v,str) and k in {'email','password','user_id','access_token','refresh_token','new_access_token','new_refresh_token'})
secrets.append((root/report['external_key_directory']/'bundle.key').read_text())
for line in (root/'.runtime/oss-core/runtime.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' in line:
        k,v=line.split('=',1)
        if any(part in k for part in ('PASSWORD','SECRET','API_KEY')): secrets.append(v)
public=[p for p in out.parent.iterdir() if p.is_file()]
check('public recovery artifacts exclude known private fixture values and keys',all(not any(s.encode() in p.read_bytes() for s in secrets if s) for p in public))
resolution=json.loads((root/'examples/python/dependency-resolution.json').read_text())
crypto=next(r for r in resolution['install'] if r['metadata']['name']=='cryptography')
wheel=root/'.cache/python-wheels'/pathlib.PurePosixPath(crypto['download_info']['url']).name
check('reused cryptography wheel pin',sha(wheel)==crypto['download_info']['archive_info']['hashes']['sha256'])
with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
    selected=['cryptography/fernet.py','cryptography-50.0.1.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE','cryptography-50.0.1.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE.APACHE','cryptography-50.0.1.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE.BSD']
    members=[{'path':name,'bytes':len(archive.read(name)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest()} for name in selected]
reuse={'kind':'file-specific-recovery-reuse','independent_license_approval':False,'authored_files':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(root/p),'origin':'New repository-authored orchestration or test; no cipher code copied'} for p in ['tools/recovery_bundle.py','tools/run_recovery_drill.py','tests/operations/recovery_probe.py','tests/operations/test_recovery_bundle.py']], 'cryptography':{'version':'50.0.1','wheel_sha256':sha(wheel),'license_expression':crypto['metadata']['license_expression'],'members':members,'installed_byte_evidence':'evidence/operations/python-offline-build/buildkit-02/distribution/distribution.json','image':report['images']['python']},'postgresql':{'image':report['images']['postgres'],'tools':['pg_dump','pg_restore'],'source_not_copied':True},'identity_session_engine':{'image':report['images']['core'],'modifications':False},'limits':['Container/native/transitive distribution review and independent human review remain open.','Existing installed-byte audit is bound to the same immutable Python image; no new binary is downloaded or bundled.']}
(root/'reuse/recovery-components.json').write_text(json.dumps(reuse,indent=2)+'\n')
result={'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Evidence integrity and private-value scan only; no additional authentication tests','passed':all(r['passed'] for r in checks),'checks':checks,'run_report_sha256':sha(out.parent/'report.json'),'probe_report_sha256':sha(out.parent/'probe-report.json'),'reuse_report_sha256':sha(root/'reuse/recovery-components.json')}
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':result['passed'],'checks':len(checks),'private_values_printed':False,'report':out.relative_to(root).as_posix()}))
